scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained for the fixed-field upper and simple-algebra lower reductions. Finite computations corroborate instances only. The simple lower-bound construction uses coefficients 0 and 1 over any field. No independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The field is fixed, given by a specified finite multiplication table; no polynomial bound in log(q) for variable q is asserted. The input includes a natural basis. No GI algorithm or optimal non-isomorphism lower bound is claimed. The classification of all simple algebras is not part of the result. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Graph-isomorphism completeness for perfect and simple evolution algebras over fixed finite fields
